description: This script serves as the entry point for starting the Voice Processing Backend FastAPI server. It sets up the environment, adds the source directory to the module search path, reads configuration from environment variables, and launches the uvicorn server with the FastAPI app defined in 'api.main'.

methods.name: _ensure_src_on_path()
methods.description: Ensures that the 'src' directory is added to sys.path for proper module resolution.

methods.name: _run()
methods.description: Prepares the environment and starts the uvicorn server with the FastAPI app.
